name: Redeem a wallet pass
description: Redeem a wallet pass. Record that a wallet pass installation was scanned or redeemed. This issues a `wallet_pass_scanned` event that can trigger automations and update contact segments (for example to track store visits, event attendance or loyalty check-ins). The request body is optional; any details supplied (location, amount spent, event tag, custom data) are carried on the event.

installationId.description: Installation ID. The unique identifier of the pass installation being redeemed (as issued when the contact added the pass to their wallet).

amountSpent.title: float
amountSpent.description: Amount spent during the visit or transaction. Useful for point-of-sale integrations and purchase tracking.

customData.description: Arbitrary key/value pairs merged into the scan event's properties, for use in automations and segmentation (e.g. register id, cashier, department). Reserved keys take precedence over the same keys supplied here: `passId` is always set by the endpoint, and `location`, `amountSpent` and `eventTag` are replaced by the matching top-level fields when those are sent.

eventTag.description: Free-form tag identifying the event or context of the scan (e.g. an event name a contact attended). Useful to segment or route automations.

location.description: Location where the scan occurred. Can be a store name, address, or any identifier relevant to your use case.

success.description: Indicates whether the scan/redemption was recorded.

execution.auth: API key in the api-key header, or OAuth 2.0. Not included here.

verification.notes: Generated from the public OpenAPI spec. Not executed.
